page-layout: full
---

This page mirrors the folder structure of the
[computational-science-tutorials](https://github.com/hgoelgithub/computational-science-tutorials) GitHub repo — one section per top-level folder.
Click **Open in Colab** to run any notebook instantly in your browser; Python scripts (`.py`)
link to their source on GitHub instead.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Running in Colab
Click any badge → sign in with Google → **Runtime → Run All**. All dependencies install automatically inside the notebook.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
A few folders keep working variants of the same tutorial (`_copy`, `_advanced`, and the `Extra/` folder) alongside supporting data files. These are listed for completeness — start with the lowest-numbered notebook in each section.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Found a bug or discrepancy? Please [get in touch via email](mailto:hgchemical@gmail.com) — feedback is always welcome.
:::
